shortDescription: Manages Out-Of-Band controllers using Redfish APIs

options.name: auth_token
options.description: Security token for authenticating to OOB controller.

options.name: ca_path
options.description: PEM formatted file that contains a CA certificate to be used for validation. Only used if O(validate_certs=true).

options.name: category
options.description: List of categories to execute on OOB controller.

options.name: ciphers
options.description: TLS/SSL Ciphers to use for the request. When a list is provided, all ciphers are joined in order with V(:). See the L(OpenSSL Cipher List Format,https://www.openssl.org/docs/manmaster/man1/openssl-ciphers.html#CIPHER-LIST-FORMAT) for more details. The available ciphers is dependent on the Python and OpenSSL/LibreSSL versions.

options.name: command
options.description: List of commands to execute on OOB controller.

options.name: manager
options.description: Name of manager on OOB controller to target.

options.name: password
options.description: Password for authenticating to OOB controller.

options.name: timeout
options.description: Timeout in seconds for HTTP requests to OOB controller. The default value for this parameter changed from V(10) to V(60) in community.general 9.0.0.

options.name: update_handle
options.description: Handle to check the status of an update in progress.

options.name: username
options.description: Username for authenticating to OOB controller.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If V(false), TLS/SSL certificates are not validated. Set this to V(true) to enable certificate checking. Should be used together with O(ca_path).
